item.title: Voices of Wards 7 and 8: What Black History Month means to D.C. this year
item.description: February is Black History Month – which, for many longtime Black D.C. residents, is every month, and inextricable from D.C. history. In an already rapidly changing city now facing growing, unprecedented challenges to its local communities, economy, and autonomy, this year’s Black History Month has new weight for some residents.
